scope: Conceptual architecture, not a discovered inventory or physical-unit coverage map.
mapping_basis: Operator-to-module associations are Omnismi interpretations, not measured kernel dispatch or vendor diagnostic claims.

profiles.scope: Selected blocks of one GPU. Counts, placement and active units are not shown.

modules.name: CUDA cores
modules.subtitle: General calculations
modules.purpose: Runs arithmetic and selection work across many parallel lanes.
modules.limitation: Results do not reveal which lanes or units ran. A mismatch cannot locate a faulty core.

modules.name: Tensor Cores
modules.subtitle: Matrix calculations
modules.purpose: Accelerates matrix multiply and accumulation.
modules.limitation: A matmul result does not prove use of this engine. Kernel dispatch and physical-unit coverage are unverified.

modules.name: Registers · L1 / shared
modules.subtitle: Nearby working data
modules.purpose: Keeps temporary values close to the compute units.
modules.limitation: No isolated register, cache or shared-memory diagnostic is implemented.

modules.name: L2 cache
modules.subtitle: Shared data reuse
modules.purpose: Reuses data between compute and device memory.
modules.limitation: Operator results do not isolate cache behavior or prove coverage of cache slices.

modules.name: GDDR7
modules.subtitle: Device memory
modules.purpose: Stores inputs, intermediate values and outputs.
modules.limitation: These are array checks, not an address sweep. Allocated memory, transfer paths and every memory bank are not verified.

modules.name: PCIe host link
modules.subtitle: CPU ↔ accelerator
modules.purpose: Connects the accelerator to its host.
modules.limitation: Input and output transfers occur during testing, but there is no dedicated link integrity test.

modules.name: RT & media engines
modules.subtitle: Ray tracing · video
modules.purpose: Handles ray tracing and video encoding or decoding.
modules.limitation: The current compute suite has no ray-tracing or video tests.
